panels.description: Destinations this node currently probes.
panels.title: Peers probed (outbound)

panels.description: Worst single peer, any of TCP/UDP/ICMP, over 15m. High here with a low inbound number means this node is the one that cannot reach out.

targets.expr: max(sum by (destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{source_node="$node", result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{source_node="$node", result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{source_node="$node", result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", "")) / sum by (destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{source_node="$node", }[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{source_node="$node", }[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{source_node="$node", }[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", "")) >= 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Worst outbound fail ratio

panels.description: Worst single peer probing INTO this node. High here with a low outbound number means peers cannot reach this node.

targets.expr: max(sum by (source_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{destination_node="$node", result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{destination_node="$node", result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{destination_node="$node", result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", "")) / sum by (source_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{destination_node="$node", }[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{destination_node="$node", }[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{destination_node="$node", }[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", "")) >= 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Worst inbound UDP loss

panels.title: MTR traces from this node (1h)

panels.description: TCP, UDP and ICMP folded together per peer. One peer standing out is a link; every peer moving together is this node.

targets.expr: (sum by (destination_node) (label_replace(rate(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{source_node="$node", result="fail"}[5m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(rate(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{source_node="$node", result="fail"}[5m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(rate(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{source_node="$node", result="fail"}[5m]), "proto", "icmp", "", "")) or 0 * sum by (destination_node) (label_replace(rate(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{source_node="$node", }[5m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(rate(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{source_node="$node", }[5m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(rate(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{source_node="$node", }[5m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))) / sum by (destination_node) (label_replace(rate(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{source_node="$node", }[5m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(rate(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{source_node="$node", }[5m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(rate(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{source_node="$node", }[5m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))

panels.description: TCP alone. Failing where UDP and ICMP do not usually means a listener or a NetworkPolicy, not the path.

targets.expr: (sum by (destination_node) (rate(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{source_node="$node", result="fail"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (destination_node) (rate(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{source_node="$node"}[5m]))) / sum by (destination_node) (rate(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{source_node="$node"}[5m]))

panels.description: UDP alone.

targets.expr: (sum by (destination_node) (rate(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{source_node="$node", result="fail"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (destination_node) (rate(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{source_node="$node"}[5m]))) / sum by (destination_node) (rate(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{source_node="$node"}[5m]))

panels.title: UDP failure ratio by peer

panels.description: ICMP alone. Flat at zero while TCP fails means the path is fine and something above it is not.

targets.expr: (sum by (destination_node) (rate(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{source_node="$node", result="fail"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (destination_node) (rate(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{source_node="$node"}[5m]))) / sum by (destination_node) (rate(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{source_node="$node"}[5m]))

panels.title: ICMP failure ratio by peer
